name: iso20022
label: ISO 20022 (Payments)
description: Global financial messaging — bank payment mandate 2024-2026

table_notes.fi_identification: Registry of financial institutions identified by BIC, with address metadata and domestic clearing system codes.
table_notes.payment_instruction: Top-level payment initiation message (PAIN.001) grouping one or more credit transfer transactions from a single debtor.
table_notes.credit_transfer_txn: Individual credit transfer transaction (PACS.008 line item) carrying amount, currency, creditor details, and end-to-end reference.
table_notes.payment_status: Audit log of status transitions for a credit transfer transaction, capturing reason codes per ISO 20022 status reporting messages.

fi_identification.name: id
fi_identification.description: Surrogate primary key for the financial institution record

fi_identification.name: bic
fi_identification.description: SWIFT BIC (ISO 9362) uniquely identifying this financial institution globally

fi_identification.name: name
fi_identification.description: Full legal name of the financial institution

fi_identification.name: clearing_system_id
fi_identification.description: Domestic clearing system member ID (e.g. ABA routing number, UK sort code)

fi_identification.name: country
fi_identification.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the institution's domicile

fi_identification.name: address
fi_identification.description: Structured postal address: {street, building_number, post_code, town, country}

payment_instruction.name: id
payment_instruction.description: Internal UUID primary key for this payment instruction

payment_instruction.name: msg_id
payment_instruction.description: Unique message ID assigned by the initiating party (PAIN.001 GrpHdr/MsgId)

payment_instruction.name: creation_dt
payment_instruction.description: Timestamp when this instruction message was created by the initiating party

payment_instruction.name: num_txns
payment_instruction.description: Number of individual credit transfer transactions grouped under this instruction

payment_instruction.name: ctrl_sum
payment_instruction.description: Sum of all transaction amounts in this instruction for reconciliation

payment_instruction.name: debtor_id
payment_instruction.description: References fi_identification — the financial institution debiting the account

payment_instruction.name: debtor_account_iban
payment_instruction.description: IBAN of the debtor account to be debited (ISO 13616)

payment_instruction.name: status
payment_instruction.description: ISO 20022 payment status code: PDNG=pending, ACCP=accepted, RJCT=rejected, PART=partial

payment_instruction.name: purpose_code
payment_instruction.description: ISO 20022 ExternalPurpose1Code classifying the economic purpose of this payment

credit_transfer_txn.name: id
credit_transfer_txn.description: Internal UUID primary key for this credit transfer transaction

credit_transfer_txn.name: instruction_id
credit_transfer_txn.description: References payment_instruction — the parent instruction group

credit_transfer_txn.name: end_to_end_id
credit_transfer_txn.description: End-to-end reference assigned by initiating party, carried unchanged through the payment chain

credit_transfer_txn.name: uetr
credit_transfer_txn.description: Unique End-to-end Transaction Reference (SWIFT gpi) for cross-border tracking

credit_transfer_txn.name: amount
credit_transfer_txn.description: Transaction amount in the specified currency

credit_transfer_txn.name: currency
credit_transfer_txn.description: ISO 4217 alphabetic currency code for this transaction

credit_transfer_txn.name: creditor_id
credit_transfer_txn.description: References fi_identification — the financial institution crediting the account

credit_transfer_txn.name: creditor_account_iban
credit_transfer_txn.description: IBAN of the creditor account to be credited (ISO 13616)

credit_transfer_txn.name: creditor_name
credit_transfer_txn.description: Full legal name of the party receiving funds

credit_transfer_txn.name: remittance_info
credit_transfer_txn.description: Free-text or structured remittance information (invoice ref, payment details) for the creditor

credit_transfer_txn.name: status
credit_transfer_txn.description: ISO 20022 transaction status code: PDNG=pending, ACSP=accepted/settled, RJCT=rejected

credit_transfer_txn.name: value_date
credit_transfer_txn.description: Requested interbank settlement date for this transaction

payment_status.name: id
payment_status.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key for this status event

payment_status.name: txn_id
payment_status.description: References credit_transfer_txn — the transaction this status event applies to

payment_status.name: status
payment_status.description: ISO 20022 status code at this point in time (e.g. ACSP, RJCT, PDNG)

payment_status.name: status_dt
payment_status.description: Timestamp when this status was recorded

payment_status.name: reason_code
payment_status.description: ISO 20022 ExternalStatusReason1Code explaining an RJCT or PDNG hold (e.g. AC01, AM04)

payment_status.name: reason_info
payment_status.description: Free-text elaboration of the reason code provided by the processing institution

short_description: Global financial messaging — bank payment mandate 2024-2026
long_description: ISO 20022 is the global financial messaging standard replacing legacy SWIFT MT messages across all payment types. The schema implements the core payment initiation (PAIN.001) and interbank clearing (PACS.008) message structures, capturing financial institution identifiers (BIC/LEI), account numbers (IBAN), transaction details, and status reporting.
when_to_use: Use for any payment processing system, banking API, treasury management platform, or fintech that must process or initiate wire transfers, ACH payments, SEPA transfers, or SWIFT gpi transactions. The US Federal Reserve completed its ISO 20022 migration in 2024; SWIFT global migration runs 2022-2026. Required for TARGET2 (ECB), CHAPS (UK), TIPS, and all G20 central bank systems.
